question: Which ATT&CK techniques do CAPEC-13, CAPEC-640 map to (they overlap), and what mitigations apply to the deduplicated union?

answer.headline: Gathered 7 record(s) from 2 source(s); 5 cross-source correlation(s) on shared identifiers.
answer.narrative: CAPEC-13 maps to T1574.006, T1574.007, and T1562.003, while CAPEC-640 maps to T1505.005, T1574.006, T1574.013, and T1620. The mitigations for the deduplicated union of these techniques include Audit (M1047), Restrict File and Directory Permissions (M1022), Execution Prevention (M1038), Restrict Registry Permissions (M1024), Operating System Configuration (M1028), and Behavior Prevention on Endpoint (M1040).
